steps.name: Angry Martial Artist
steps.text: Let us out.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: We've been through this.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: The General has declared a high alert to ensure Yumen's safety. No one is allowed to leave the city without permission.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Turn back.

steps.name: Angry Martial Artist
steps.text: You dare speak of Yumen's safety to me?

steps.name: Angry Martial Artist
steps.text: We were guarding Yumen long before you even picked up a stick, kiddo!

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: In times like these, I need you to think about the greater good.

steps.name: Angry Martial Artist
steps.text: The greater good?

steps.name: Angry Martial Artist
steps.text: Do you remember when a group of bandits infiltrated the city and injured innocent people in the process?

steps.name: Angry Martial Artist
steps.text: It happened so suddenly, and the situation was so messy that you refused to lift a finger, so we had to take things into our own hands. We chased them hundreds of li and spent three whole days in the desert.

steps.name: Angry Martial Artist
steps.text: We had to carry half our brothers back to the city, but we managed to drag the bandits along with us.

steps.name: Angry Martial Artist
steps.text: Now our brothers lie dead out there, their bodies still rotting, and you're asking us to wait?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Master Jing, we all know your story, and we have infinite respect for you.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: But General Zuo has decreed that while we are hunting a serious criminal, no one is to leave the city without his permission.

steps.name: Angry Martial Artist
steps.text: His awe-inspiring authority has me quaking!

steps.name: Angry Martial Artist
steps.text: Tell that Zuo Xuanliao to come out here and face us!
Impudence!

steps.name: Angry Martial Artist
steps.text: Master Meng...

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I heard you shouting from across the city. These men are only following orders. Why do you have to be so hard on them?

steps.name: Angry Martial Artist
steps.text: We just, can't let them talk to us like this...

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: You're venerable elders of our city.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: You've fought many battles to defend Yumen, even Messengers through Catastrophes. Our stability is thanks to your hard work.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Even though the Lord Exorcist and Grandmaster are still present, you dare to flaunt your seniority as if it matters?!

steps.name: Disappointed Martial Artist
steps.text: Have you no heart...?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Good men need not remind the people of their past deeds. If you need to boast about it, that just goes to show how little it truly mattered.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Go home and make no further trouble. I will ensure your fallen brothers are spoken for.

steps.name: Disappointed Martial Artist
steps.text: ...Yes, Master.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: The blame lies with me, I neglected their discipline.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: We would never blame you.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: About those four brothers... you have my condolences.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I'll take care of their families. There's no need to bother the Lord Exorcist.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: But since they died delivering a letter for Yumen, I'd like to ask the Lord Exorcist his opinion on the situation.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: We have to focus on the assassin for now, but when we're done, the Lord Exorcist will absolutely dispatch troops to clear out the bandits.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Right... you have to prioritize, that makes sense.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I just want a word with the Lord Exorcist. I need a reply, any kind of reply, to answer to those brothers.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Once we are done with this, you are all welcome to the Sword Forge for drinks.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Yühsia.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: How's the situation on your end? Have the families of the victims been located?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Actually, two of the four were living alone.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: As for the other two, their families happened to be away from home, so we took it upon ourselves to barge in.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: It's a bit strange that all their homes looked so normal on the inside.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Could it be a coincidence that they all just happened to be out?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: A whole day has passed since we got the news of their deaths.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Who goes there?!

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: You scared the life out of me!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I just felt like someone was watching us.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: You could sense that even in this crowd?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Let's continue this inside the inn.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Lin Yühsia, stay your steps.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You know this man...?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Just give me a moment, I'll have a few words with him.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I didn't expect the Monitor Censor of the Department of Discipline and Supervision to remember me. I think it's been five years since we last met?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: The timing of our meeting was a memorable one.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: But not very pleasant.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Just official business, you and I both.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Are you also here to investigate the events that have transpired in Yumen, Envoy Lin?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Can the Monitor Censor offer any leads?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: No. At this time, I am not intervening in an official capacity.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: I am merely acting as a former subordinate of the Lord Exorcist and as a subject of Yan, to apprehend the villains who disturb the people's peace.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I must say, I'm a little surprised that you aren't advising me to stay out of it, Monitor Censor Taihe.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: I have no reason to dissuade you from your duties, Envoy Lin.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Do forgive me for prying, Envoy Lin. You have only just arrived in the city, so how exactly do you plan to investigate a case when you are yet unfamiliar with the situation?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I have my own means, of course. Don't you worry, Monitor Censor Taihe.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: I have no doubt your means will prove more than adequate, Envoy Lin.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You might as well make your words clearer, Monitor Censor Taihe.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: As I said, we are on official business, and nothing more than that.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: I merely offer a reminder, Envoy Lin: the enemy lies in the open while we are hidden. But do be careful still.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: I will take my leave.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I've seen that big guy before, in Shangshu... I think he was from the Department of Discipline and Supervision?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Just how many mandarins do you know?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It's not like we're friends. We just have prior dealings.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: What's the difference?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The difference is that you don't want to be friends with some people you have dealings with.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Let's go.
Dusk.
The sun goes down quickly in early spring, and the weather is still a little cold.
The old man fills the furnace with a handful of firewood.
The weak fire is not fit for forging or even for heating. These days, all the forge equipment runs on Originium, but the old man stubbornly keeps such a useless furnace here.

While waiting for the fire to intensify, he picks up a broom and carefully sweeps up the sand that has accumulated in the courtyard overnight, leaving none of the crevices between the stone bricks untouched.
Of course, the old man knows that it will only stay clean for a moment and will soon return to its sandy state.
But he still toils to sweep the ground over and over again, as if hoping to catch a glimpse of a completely clean forge.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: These legs of mine are still ache from the cold, even the weather is getting warmer.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: It's about closing time. If it isn't urgent, why not come back tomorrow?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Are you looking for someplace else, girl? This is a forge, not a clinic.

steps.name: Exotically Dressed Girl
steps.text: I'm looking for... a place, mentioned in a story...

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: You're hurt too bad to be running around the city like this.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I hate to say it, but the city is under high alert right now. And a girl with a knife wound has shown up on my doorstep.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: It'll be trouble for me if I don't take her in to the authorities.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: The last thing I want is more trouble, so I'd better get her to explain where she came from.

steps.name: Exotically Dressed Girl
steps.text: You.. are you the one called Meng Tieyi?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: It means something that you know the name, young as you are.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: But I don't recognize you at all.

steps.name: Exotically Dressed Girl
steps.text: Shifu told me there is a forge hidden here in the nomadic city. And that the owner of the forge is a skilled swordsmith.

steps.name: Exotically Dressed Girl
steps.text: He can make all kinds of weapons and armor, and also craft toys for the children of the city.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I can't recall anyone who would talk about this old man like that.

steps.name: Exotically Dressed Girl
steps.text: In the yard of the forge lies a pagoda tree, transplanted by the both of you from a faraway place.
The old man can't help but look back.
In the corner of the yard stands a pagoda tree, leaves swaying slightly against the evening wind. Spring comes late in the north, and new leaves have yet to grow on the branches.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Now can we say that the battle is truly over.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: We've suffered a number of casualties... but for the next twenty years at least, these bandits will be cowed.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: I've heard tales from long ago, of expeditions celebrating their triumphs by carving out their achievements on the furthest mountains they could see. Perhaps today we are worthy of that legacy.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Hahaha. Not a bad idea, but we have only sand around us, and nothing solid on which to write.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: There is a lone tree here, so why not...?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Good! Let's go with that!

steps.name: Swordswoman
steps.text: Good?! This withered tree is about to crumble into dust, and you still want to torment it?

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Do you have an alternative then?

steps.name: Swordswoman
steps.text: What's the point of engraving your exploits on a fixed point when we live in a nomadic city that regularly travels thousands of li?

steps.name: Swordswoman
steps.text: Why not we take this tree back and replant it in Yumen?

steps.name: Swordswoman
steps.text: Our story will be remembered by the tree, if it manages to take root in the city, even for just a day.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: *claps once*

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Very well. Not a bad idea at all.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Did you get heatstroke from being out here too long? We're at least a hundred li from Yumen. Are you planning to carry the tree all the way back there?

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Why not? We carried so much food and water on the way here and now it's all gone, so what's wrong with bringing an extra tree on our way back?

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: General Zuo, Tieyi, please lend me a hand. Careful not to damage the roots.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: You called her Shifu...?

steps.name: Exotically Dressed Girl
steps.text: Shifu saved mine and my family's lives out in the wilderness, and taught us how live among the settled.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: What is your name?

steps.name: Exotically Dressed Girl
steps.text: Jieyun.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: If I'm not mistaken, you're an Anasa... yet you have such a refined name?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Shifu gave it to me.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: No wonder.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Yun dong qian li yu, jie zai ci shan qing. A classic poem. The cloud floats for a thousand li until it finally settles upon a mountaintop. She wished for you to find a home, like the cloud.

spans.text: zai ci shan qing. A classic poem. The cloud floats for a thousand li until it finally settles upon a mountaintop. She wished for you to find a home, like the cloud.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Shifu recited it better than you, but the meaning is the same.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Ahah, I have no doubt.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Come to think of it, she gave the Grandmaster his name as well.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: That fickle-minded heartless man!

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: What's this then...?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Hold on, that sword you're carrying...

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: You stole the Grandmaster's sword?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I will bring it to Shifu's grave, as an offering.
The wind whips up the leaves, rustling the old pagoda tree.
The fire in the furnace has died down, and the sky grown dark. But the old man does not move.
The girl can't see his expression clearly.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: She—she's dead?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Yes. Shifu's illness was very serious.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Her last wish was to look upon this sword one last time, so I must deliver it to her.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Do you want it too?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Certainly not.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Yumen is a very dangerous place to be right now.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I know that with this sword on me, all the soldiers will be hunting for me.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: No, what I'm saying is... the city will become even more dangerous in the near future.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: It's about to face a test. But before that, I should at the very least try to get you out.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Your shifu is waiting for you... as are all of us.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: But how do you get out of the city?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I didn't think about it when I came in. They sealed the gates, so I tried to force my way through... and was injured in the process.
The wind picks up.
A handful of fine sand flies onto the old man's face, and into the gap of time that has gone by.
It is soft, moist from the twilight hours of early spring
The old man kneads the sand in his fingers.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I have an idea.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hey, welcome back.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What's the word?

steps.name: Errand Runner
steps.text: No doctor or staff in the clinic, just some princely-looking official who asked me what I was doing.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: And what did you tell him...?

steps.name: Errand Runner
steps.text: Just what you told me, 'Last night, I hurried over with a family member in tow, who suffered a concussion when our store shelves collapsed. We forgot to bring money for the bill, so I came back today to make the payment.'

steps.name: Errand Runner
steps.text: The nobleman left after asking me the question. I don't get it.

steps.name: Errand Runner
steps.text: Here's your money back, since I never had to pay anyone.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Just keep it, take it as reimbursement for your hard work.

steps.name: Errand Runner
steps.text: It's so strange... is Yumen's tourist season that lucrative?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: I've heard of Mr. Lee's skill, but to even pull one over on the young like that?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: That just any kid. He's a Sui Regulator Candleholder, I wouldn't dare lie to him...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Just helping him rule out a wrong answer.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: As for Mr. Lin, what are you doing here...?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Just out for a stroll.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: If we were in Lungmen Park right now, I'd believe it.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: And how are things coming along for you, Mr. Lee?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It's a little strange. I haven't been able to figure out exactly what the job is you've asked me to do, but the one I've been looking for might be able to clue me in.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: That's good to hear.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You've tasked me with the job, but you still look uneasy. Why not take matters into your own hands?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Any action I take would affect Wei Yenwu's reputation.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: I also want to just watch from the sidelines and see how she does things.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Now that's the Mr. Lin I know. This is an important moment, but there's still ample time to make a probing move.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: A beard well lathered is already half shaved. I have trust in you as well, Mr. Lee.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Wei Yenwu has often lamented your decision to not stay with the L.G.D.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Let's not talk about that...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Wei Yenwu... doesn't let go of somebody, if he's decided they're useful to him.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Speaking of which, are you still determined to have your girl Yühsia take over your work?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: That's not for me to decide.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: If she wants to stay, Lungmen will have a place for her. If she wants to leave, Lungmen won't trouble her.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: I would like you to take care of her, no matter what path she takes, Mr. Lee.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It's an honor to have your trust, Mr. Lin.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: If there's anything I can do to help out, I will give it my all.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Do ze.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Now then, time to stop bothering you and continue my stroll.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Oh, Huai Tianpei... he's a father too...?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Did you see the city-wide notice issued by the Patrol Battalion on your way here?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: According to the Imperial Astronomical Bureau's latest calculations, Yumen needs to adjust course to avoid a Catastrophe.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Starting tomorrow, at the Hour of Shen, the city will begin to slow down. By around the Hour of Yu, it will have dropped to its lowest speed, and will pick up again once the course has corrected.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Your chance lies within that timeframe.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: But if the city slows down, won't the gates be even more closely guarded?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Dear girl, did you take a good look around you before entering Yumen?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: A desert spanning thousands of li, with only misfortune and the occasional traveler to meet, but a part of Yanese territory still. From the very beginning, Yumen was designed as a military fortress to guard the north.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Which is why the city has 'sand sluices' in dams on the outer wall, unlike conventional nomadic cities.

a.text: It is said that a Tumu Tianshi took inspiration from the 'water wheels' in the Jiangnan waterways and fitted it onto this border city.
The base of the city sinks into the sand, but the huge dams powered by Arts are always running to disperse the sand and remove all forms of resistance.
Thanks to these 'sand sluices,' the city of Yumen is able to move flexibly across the vast desert and adapt to any situation.
Like a river current, it moves with the tide, a spectacular sight to behold.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Normally, the sand sluice would never serve as a path for people to walk on.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: If one jumps into the sand sluice, he can only expect to be crushed by the turbines, or suffocate under the rolling yellow sand.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: So tomorrow, at the Hour of Yu, when Yumen is travelling at its lowest speed, the flow of sand through the sluices will also be slowed... but at least there's a ghost of a chance in this idea.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I'll do it! I need to get out of the city, by any means.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: But what about your wounds?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I'll manage.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I went to a clinic earlier.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: It's just that, security around the sand sluices is usually lax, but I'm not sure if things have changed now with the city under high alert.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: On my way here, I heard the general of this city is personally leading the defense of the keep.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: It seems...

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: To meet or not to meet, that was the question. But it seems the answer is meet.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: You're going out?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: We have to be quick, I need to go scout the surroundings. There are also some preparations to be made, if you're to leave the city via the sand sluices.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I'll hang a 'Closed' sign on the door while I'm out, so make use of this time to recuperate.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I'll come back to fetch you.
Daai Siu Ze.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Yühsia?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Head up to my room first, I'll be there in a minute.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Any news?

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: Not long after you left, some people in smiths' clothes showed up, moved their goods and headed someplace else.

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: I tried to follow them, but they seem to be in our line of work. They realized someone was tailing them and quickly shook me off their trail.

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: I returned to the warehouse to take another look, and it had been cleared out completely. I don't know what these people are hiding, but it's clear that something strange is going on.

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: Your intuition was spot on, there's something off about that Sword Forge.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'm afraid we've already set the enemy on alert, and we've yet to find our key evidence.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The dark clouds over the city get thicker every day, while the sand in the wind is also denser.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The situation is urgent. Since we have our suspects, we can try some things out.

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: Daai Siu Ze?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Go to the barracks and fetch something for me.
